_comment: Phase 7 (2026-10-29): noise-targeted alignment (align.sem_t_weights), ARM=proj, training seed 42, k=28,
same datasets / fractions / seeds / c_grid as phase2.json. dinov3-sat first (cells cached from phase 1) for the
teacher deltas. Task index = 6 * model + dataset. proj-semt-hi = L_SEM on t in {580, 740, 900} only
(weights 0 0 0 0 0 0 1 1 1), proj-semt-lo = L_SEM on t in {100, 180} only (1 1 0 0 0 0 0 0 0); FM sampling
unchanged. so2sat + bigearthnet only (dataset indices 3 and 5). The extractor's lora tag is the arm (proj);
the run dir in the features path is what distinguishes the two. Pre-registered readout in OUTLINE §1 / §4.7.

2026-11-07: semt-lo x m_bigearthnet opts in to drop_nonfinite_train_rows (user decision): train image 19538 has non-finite features at t=180, blocks >= 8 (one forward pass), so the 100 % cell fits on 19,999 rows; recorded per cell as dropped_train_rows, not part of the cell identity (eval/matrix.py cell_config).
